user.title: HRI Probe
user.description: A test integration: it creates one entity on every platform Home Assistant has.

data_description.name: Must not start or end with a space; the name "crash" aborts the flow with "unknown".
data_description.initial: The value every entity starts from.

path.title: How much do you want to configure?
path.description: Basic creates the entry now; advanced asks one question per selector kind; probe waits first.

advanced.title: Advanced settings for {name}
advanced.description: One field per selector shape a flow renderer has to cope with.

data_description.level: A number selector in slider mode.
data_description.retries: A number selector in box mode.
data_description.profile: A select selector in dropdown mode; one option has a space in it.
data_description.speed: A select selector in list mode, with labels of its own.
data_description.extra: An object selector: every value must be a number.
data_description.window: A duration selector, the shape no renderer is obliged to know.
data_description.limits: A form section: its fields arrive as one nested object.

limits.name: Limits
limits.description: A collapsible section inside the form.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure {title}
reconfigure.description: Changes the data of the existing entry; the entry itself is kept.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate HRI Probe
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {name} expired. The only token that works is "probe-token".

error.invalid_name: The name must not start or end with a space.
error.invalid_object: Every value in the object must be a number.
error.invalid_auth: That is not the token this probe expects.

abort.already_in_progress: A flow for this name is already open.
abort.unknown: The flow failed with an error it did not expect.

init.title: HRI Probe options
init.description: Two branches, so a renderer meets an options menu as well as a config one.

tuning.title: Tuning
tuning.description: The profile chosen here decides which fields the next step asks for.

data_description.profile: "aggressive" leads to a different second step than the others.

tuning_detail.title: Tuning detail ({profile})
tuning_detail.description: This schema was built from the profile chosen on the previous step.

tick.name: Tick
tick.description: Change the entities that have no service of their own (sensors, binary sensor, event, device tracker).

flap.name: Flap availability
flap.description: Make every hri_probe entity unavailable, then available again.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long the entities stay unavailable.

notify.name: Persistent notification
notify.description: Create or dismiss a persistent notification.

notification_id.name: Notification id
notification_id.description: Same id replaces the previous notification.

dismiss.name: Dismiss
dismiss.description: Dismiss the notification with that id instead of creating it.

echo.name: Echo
echo.description: Answer with the payload it was called with (a service that returns a response).

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: Any JSON object; it comes back in the response.

fail.name: Fail
fail.description: Raise an error, to check how a failed call is reported.

slow.name: Slow call
slow.description: Take longer than the caller's timeout.

stuck.name: Block an executor thread
stuck.description: Test case - one executor thread waits forever.

expire_auth.name: Expire the authentication
expire_auth.description: Make the config entry fail authentication, so Home Assistant starts the reauth flow.

entry_id.name: Entry id
entry_id.description: Which entry; empty means every hri_probe entry.
